instruction: Repair the records package so its public API meets every README requirement. Reported defect: Sort dot-separated numeric version strings by numeric components, preserving duplicates. Preserve unrelated behavior and inputs. Return JSON with changes [{path, content}] containing complete UTF-8 text for each modified allowed source file, and explanation. files.README.md:
# Owned diagnostic repository: records

Public API: candidate_app.handle({operation, payload}). Inputs must remain unchanged.

- versions: Sort dot-separated numeric version strings by numeric components, preserving duplicates.
- csv_row: Encode one CSV row using standard CSV quoting and no trailing line terminator.
- merge: Merge override fields into defaults. An explicit null overrides a default; absent fields preserve it. Never mutate inputs.
- page: Return a one-based page of records of positive size; an out-of-range page returns empty.
- latest: Keep the record with greatest numeric revision for each ID; on ties keep the first. Return records sorted by ID.

Run public checks with: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
